_comment: Editorial content for ASTM. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the company publishes product and plant photographs on its own site but no licence permitting reuse, and a generic textile photograph would imply it is theirs.
description: Asim Textile Mills Limited is a public limited textile company based in Faisalabad, incorporated in 1990 and taken over by its current group around 1994. It manufactures and sells yarn and home textile products, with its mill on Sheikhupura Road and its head office at J.K. House in Madina Town. The home-textile side of the business is presented as finished bed and bath furnishings — sheet sets, duvet sets, comforters and curtains.
headOffice: J.K. House, 32-W Main Boulevard, Susan Road, Madina Town, Faisalabad, Pakistan
